mapper.sql: select goods_id, sum(`number`) as stock_total from litemall_goods_product where deleted = 0 group by goods_id
select og.goods_id, sum(og.number) as sales_qty from litemall_order_goods og join litemall_order o on o.id = og.order_id and o.order_status >= 201 where og.deleted = 0 group by og.goods_id
mapper.select: select count(*) as onSaleCount, coalesce(sum(case when g.add_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 7 day) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as newArrivals7d, coalesce(sum(coalesce(p.stock_total, 0)), 0) as stockUnits, coalesce(sum(case when coalesce(p.stock_total, 0) <= #{lowStock} then 1 else 0 end), 0) as lowStockCount, coalesce(sum(case when md.available = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as unavailableCount, round(avg(case when g.cost > 0 and g.retail_price > 0 then (g.retail_price - g.cost) / g.retail_price * 100 end), 2) as avgMarginPct, round(coalesce(sum(case when g.cost > 0 then (g.retail_price - g.cost) * least(coalesce(p.stock_total, 0), #{stockCap}) end), 0), 2) as potentialProfit from litemall_goods g left join () p on p.goods_id = g.id left join litemall_product_metric_daily md on md.goods_id = g.id and md.`day` = #{day} where g.deleted = 0 and g.is_on_sale = 1 and g.category_id in #{cid}

select count(*) from litemall_goods g where g.deleted = 0
and g.category_id in #{cid}

select (select count(*) from litemall_footprint f where f.goods_id = #{goodsId} and f.deleted = 0) as views, coalesce((select sum(og.number) from litemall_order_goods og join litemall_order o on o.id = og.order_id and o.order_status >= 201 where og.goods_id = #{goodsId} and og.deleted = 0), 0) as salesQty, round(coalesce((select sum(og.number * og.price) from litemall_order_goods og join litemall_order o on o.id = og.order_id and o.order_status >= 201 where og.goods_id = #{goodsId} and og.deleted = 0), 0), 2) as revenue, (select count(*) from litemall_collect c where c.value_id = #{goodsId} and c.type = 0 and c.deleted = 0) as collects, (select count(*) from litemall_comment cm where cm.value_id = #{goodsId} and cm.type = 0 and cm.deleted = 0) as comments

select dc.id as id, dc.goods_id as goodsId, g.`name` as name, g.pic_url as picUrl, dc.`day` as day, dc.tier as tier, dc.score as score, case when g.cost > 0 then g.cost end as cost, g.retail_price as retailPrice, dc.suggested_deal_price as suggestedDealPrice, coalesce(p.stock_total, 0) as stockTotal, g.rating as rating, dc.status as status, dc.reasons as reasons from litemall_deal_candidate dc join litemall_goods g on g.id = dc.goods_id and g.deleted = 0 left join () p on p.goods_id = dc.goods_id where dc.deleted = 0 and dc.`day` = #{day} order by dc.score desc, dc.id asc
select goods_id as goodsId, count(*) as cnt from litemall_footprint where deleted = 0 and add_time >= #{day} and add_time < date_add(#{day}, interval 1 day) group by goods_id

select og.goods_id as goodsId, sum(og.number) as cnt from litemall_order_goods og join litemall_order o on o.id = og.order_id and o.order_status >= 201 where og.deleted = 0 and o.pay_time >= #{day} and o.pay_time < date_add(#{day}, interval 1 day) group by og.goods_id
mapper.sql: select goods_id, count(*) as views from litemall_footprint where deleted = 0 group by goods_id
mapper.select: select rc.id as id, rc.goods_id as goodsId, g.`name` as name, g.pic_url as picUrl, g.category_id as categoryId, case when g.cost > 0 then g.cost end as cost, g.retail_price as retailPrice, case when g.cost > 0 and g.retail_price > 0 then round((g.retail_price - g.cost) / g.retail_price * 100, 2) end as marginPct, coalesce(p.stock_total, 0) as stockTotal, case when (select md.available from litemall_product_metric_daily md where md.goods_id = g.id order by md.`day` desc limit 1) = 0 then coalesce(datediff(curdate(), (select max(md2.`day`) from litemall_product_metric_daily md2 where md2.goods_id = g.id and md2.available = 1)), datediff(curdate(), g.add_time)) else 0 end as unavailableDays, coalesce(v.views, 0) as views, coalesce(s.sales_qty, 0) as salesQty, rc.score as score, rc.reasons as reasons, rc.status as status, rc.execute_on as executeOn, rc.`day` as day from litemall_retire_candidate rc join litemall_goods g on g.id = rc.goods_id and g.deleted = 0 left join () p on p.goods_id = rc.goods_id left join () s on s.goods_id = rc.goods_id left join () v on v.goods_id = rc.goods_id where rc.deleted = 0 and rc.status = #{status} order by rc.`day` desc, rc.score desc, rc.id asc limit #{limit}

select g.id as goodsId, case when g.cost > 0 and g.retail_price > 0 then round((g.retail_price - g.cost) / g.retail_price * 100, 2) end as marginPct, coalesce(p.stock_total, 0) as stockTotal, coalesce(s.sales_qty, 0) as salesQty, coalesce(v.views, 0) as views, (select md.available from litemall_product_metric_daily md where md.goods_id = g.id order by md.`day` desc limit 1) as latestAvailable, g.add_time as arrivalDate from litemall_goods g left join () p on p.goods_id = g.id left join () s on s.goods_id = g.id left join () v on v.goods_id = g.id where g.deleted = 0 and g.is_on_sale = 1 and g.source = 'cj' order by coalesce(s.sales_qty, 0) asc, coalesce(v.views, 0) asc, case when g.cost > 0 and g.retail_price > 0 then (g.retail_price - g.cost) / g.retail_price else -1 end asc, coalesce(p.stock_total, 0) asc, g.add_time asc, g.id asc limit #{limit}
select count(*) from litemall_goods g where g.deleted = 0 and g.is_on_sale = 1 and g.source = 'cj'

select count(*) as arrivals, round(avg(case when g.cost > 0 and g.retail_price > 0 then (g.retail_price - g.cost) / g.retail_price * 100 end), 2) as avgMarginPct, round(avg(g.retail_price), 2) as avgRetailPrice, round(coalesce(avg(dsc.score), 0), 2) as dealScore from litemall_goods g left join (select goods_id, max(score) as score from litemall_deal_candidate where deleted = 0 and `day` >= #{sinceDay} group by goods_id) dsc on dsc.goods_id = g.id where g.deleted = 0 and g.is_on_sale = 1 and g.source = 'cj' and g.add_time >= #{since} and g.category_id in #{cid}

select count(*) as goodsCount, round(avg(g.retail_price), 2) as avgPriceNow, round(avg(g.cost * #{margin}), 2) as avgPriceAt, round(coalesce(sum((g.retail_price - g.cost) * least(coalesce(p.stock_total, 0), #{stockCap})), 0), 2) as potentialProfitNow, round(coalesce(sum((g.cost * #{margin} - g.cost) * least(coalesce(p.stock_total, 0), #{stockCap})), 0), 2) as potentialProfitAt from litemall_goods g left join () p on p.goods_id = g.id where g.deleted = 0 and g.is_on_sale = 1 and g.cost > 0 and g.category_id in #{cid}

select distinct gp.cj_vid from litemall_goods_product gp join litemall_goods g on g.id = gp.goods_id and g.source = 'cj' and g.deleted = 0 where gp.deleted = 0 and gp.cj_vid is not null and gp.cj_vid != '' and (gp.goods_id in (select goods_id from litemall_seckill where price_swapped = 1 and is_del = 0 and deleted = 0) or gp.goods_id in (select goods_id from litemall_deal_candidate where status = 'proposed' and deleted = 0 and `day` >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 7 day)))

select g.id as goodsId, g.category_id as categoryId, g.retail_price as retailPrice, g.cost as cost, round((g.retail_price - g.cost) / g.retail_price * 100, 2) as marginPct, coalesce(p.stock_total, 0) as stockTotal, coalesce(s.sales_qty, 0) as salesQty, coalesce(v.views, 0) as views, g.rating as rating, g.review_count as reviewCount, g.add_time as arrivalDate from litemall_goods g left join () p on p.goods_id = g.id left join () s on s.goods_id = g.id left join () v on v.goods_id = g.id where g.deleted = 0 and g.is_on_sale = 1 and g.source = 'cj' and g.cost > 0 and g.retail_price > 0 order by (g.retail_price - g.cost) / g.retail_price desc, coalesce(p.stock_total, 0) desc, g.id asc limit #{limit}

select pc.id as id, pc.goods_id as goodsId, g.`name` as name, g.pic_url as picUrl, g.category_id as categoryId, pc.kind as kind, pc.`day` as day, pc.tier as tier, pc.score as score, case when g.cost > 0 then g.cost end as cost, g.retail_price as retailPrice, case when g.cost > 0 and g.retail_price > 0 then round((g.retail_price - g.cost) / g.retail_price * 100, 2) end as marginPct, coalesce(p.stock_total, 0) as stockTotal, g.rating as rating, g.review_count as reviewCount, pc.suggestion as suggestion, pc.reasons as reasons, pc.status as status, pc.ref_id as refId from litemall_promo_candidate pc join litemall_goods g on g.id = pc.goods_id and g.deleted = 0 left join () p on p.goods_id = pc.goods_id where pc.deleted = 0 and pc.kind = #{kind} and pc.`day` = #{day} and pc.status = #{status} order by pc.score desc, pc.id asc
